facts.value: The six-entry Lip's Stick ItemStateTable supplies an animation ID and animation, physics, and collision callbacks for each motion-state index. Item_80268E5C indexes the table by msid, copies the selected row's anim_id, uses that animation ID to select the article's animation descriptor, and installs the row's callbacks. Motion-state indices and animation IDs are distinct.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing characterization of the leading member as a state/animation flag using the canonical dispatcher.

evidence.why: Six table rows and leading values.
Separate motion-state indexing, animation-ID lookup and callback installation.

facts.value: At source level, it_803F6310 is an array of six ItemStateTable records. Each initializer supplies an animation ID followed by animation, physics, and collision callback pointers; row 2 has a null collision callback. Compiled section placement, byte size and record stride are not established by the source evidence reviewed here.
facts.rationale: Preserves the supported array shape, corrects the leading field, and removes unsupported compiled allocation claims.

facts.value: Rows 0 through 5 provide resting/grounded, ordinary falling, held, thrown, dropped, and EnteredAir-selected behavior respectively. Row 2 has no collision callback. Rows 3 and 4 share physics but use distinct collision handlers. Their animation ID is 1; rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 use animation ID 0. These animation IDs are not motion-state indices or state-change flags.
facts.rationale: Retains the established state mapping while correcting the semantic meaning of the leading 0/1 values.

evidence.why: Animation ID selects descriptor separately from msid.

facts.value: Reads xD4C and, when it is nonzero, obtains a contact mask from it_8026DAA8. If any low-nibble bit is set, an additionally nonzero xDAC_itcmd_var0 causes it_8029A218(owner, &pos, facing_dir, 0) to be requested and the flag to be cleared; this does not decrement xD4C and does not wait for allocation success. The contact mask then flows to it_80276FC4. If mask bit 1 is set and it_8026DBC8 accepts the contact, the function reacquires Item, sets xDC8_word.flags.x15 through it_8026B390, zeroes velocity, and selects motion state 0 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE. The nonzero-ammunition path returns false; exactly zero ammunition bypasses it and returns it_8026DF34(gobj).
facts.rationale: Corrects the claimed collision-state clearing and restores the pending-flag guard, resource behavior and exceptional constructor-failure semantics.

evidence.why: Helper sets x15 rather than clearing collision state.

facts.value: State 5 is selected by itLipstick_Logic23_EnteredAir. Its collision callback delegates to it_8026E8C4 and always returns false. When the resolver finds no floor support, it performs leave-ground setup and invokes it_8029583C to select state 1. With support present, it performs further contact processing and invokes it_802957AC only when xDC8_word.flags.x1F is clear or xD5C is zero. That callback sets xDC8_word.flags.x15, zeroes velocity and selects state 0; it does not itself clear collision state. If the grounded-exit guard fails, this resolver does not select a new motion state.
facts.rationale: Corrects the setup helper's effect and makes the guarded persistence of state 5 explicit.

evidence.why: State-5 entry, delegation and false return.
No-floor exit and guarded grounded exit.
